entities.name: Kynaios
entities.description: Legendary human soldier of Theros who with Tiro overthrew Agnomakhos.

entities.name: Tiro
entities.description: Legendary human soldier of Theros, lover of Kynaios.

entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: Immortal archon and tyrant who ruled a mighty empire before Meletis.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: God said to have granted humans magic to overthrow the archon.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: Largest polis on Theros, founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire.

entities.name: Oxus
entities.description: Settlement in the Meletian holdings with Kynaios and Tiro's tomb.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: Agnomakhos's guard, cast out by humans.

events.summary: Kynaios and Tiro rise to challenge the tyrant Agnomakhos and the people rally to them.
events.quote: Kynaios and Tiro rose to challenge him
The people rallied to their cause, and Agnomakhos was defeated.

events.summary: Meletis is founded on the ruins of the empire and chooses Kynaios and Tiro as guardians.
events.quote: Its people chose Kynaios and Tiro to be its guardians.

relations.note: joined by their love for one another
relations.quote: joined by their love for one another and freedom
Kynaios and Tiro rose to challenge him

relations.note: legend says she granted humans magic
relations.quote: The legend says that the god Ephara granted humans magic to help them overthrow the archon
